hero.headline: Learning on the go
hero.subtext: Use Sodafom in a web browser today. Mobile store releases and offline play are planned, not live.

features.title: Offline play planned
features.description: Downloaded lessons are a goal for a future tested mobile release.

features.title: Daily reminders
features.description: Gentle push notifications remind children to complete their daily challenge.

features.title: Multi-child profiles
features.description: Switch between up to 4 child profiles with a single tap — no logging out.

features.title: Badges & stars sync
features.description: Progress syncs instantly across phone, tablet, and browser — always up to date.

features.title: Full-colour games
features.description: Every game is optimised for small screens with large tap targets and bold visuals.

features.title: Child-safe
features.description: No adverts, no in-app purchases, no social features. Just safe, focused learning.

items.title: Open the web app
items.description: Use Sodafom in a supported phone, tablet or computer browser.

items.title: Sign in or sign up
items.description: Use your existing Sodafom account or create one free in under a minute.

items.title: Add your children
items.description: Enter each child's name and age group — the app personalises games instantly.

items.title: Start playing!
items.description: Pick a game, earn stars, and unlock badges. Learning has never been this fun.

cta.headline: Ready to start learning?
cta.subtext: Try the live web app while the mobile versions are being planned and tested.
cta.button: Try it free in your browser
